answer: The queue moves one name at a time, and every name in it has already paid. The toll does the work that no ban list ever could. Nobody is waved through free: a waiting period of 26 days that no payment can shorten is the price, and the tide never covers it twice. The desk only stamps a name that carries Maltbound perry maker malt bond, and the stamp itself rests on a bond perry makers lodge after cider mill checks. Every pearl is counted once. The clerk notes timber.
